reason: The hypothesis synthesizes active-learning ML potentials, sparse DFT corrections, and uncertainty-aware umbrella integration into a single workflow for fusion free energies of multicomponent HEAs, a combination not proposed in any passage. It targets a specific gap (cost of free energy in both solid and fluid phases with full anharmonicity and electron-vibration coupling) and defines a falsification benchmark, going beyond individual method demonstrations.
